openings.claim: Making the completed sample an active comparison reference for each envelope may reduce omissions for participants and rework for the two assemblers. This evaluates a bounded probe; achieving 60 complete, correctly assigned kits within 90 minutes and at most one distribution correction remains unproven.
openings.delta: Each volunteer compares actual contents with the assigned pattern's existing sample before closing an envelope, explicitly matching quantities and dimensions. At distribution, use the same sample comparison to verify pattern correspondence. Parent B remains the sole proposed mechanism.
openings.prediction: If insufficient sample consultation causes omissions, repeated comparisons should expose missing or wrong-quantity items before closure and leave fewer distribution corrections than the stipulated seven omissions, while consultation time may threaten the 90-minute limit.
openings.rival_prediction: Shared-material picking interference is the nearest alternative explanation: the loose-material batch had no omissions. If interference dominates, sample consultation will increase but shared-item omissions or correction time will persist, preventing the full target.
openings.defeat: A representative 60-kit probe with documented comparisons that still exceeds 90 minutes, leaves more than one kit requiring correction, or distributes a kit to the wrong assigned pattern defeats qualification under the full requirements. Unchanged omissions despite comparisons weaken the causal hypothesis.
openings.probe: Using exactly two volunteers and existing envelopes, samples, supplies and tally sheets, rehearse all 60 assigned kits on the existing table. Include consultation, replenishment, checking and assignment verification in one timed session; stop at 90 minutes. Record omissions caught before closure, remaining corrections, wrong-pattern handoffs and completed kits. Do not relax contents or dimensions.
assumptions: Samples accurately represent every specified quantity and dimension.
The representative pattern mixture and participant assignments are available.
Existing supplies suffice; O5 does not establish full stock sufficiency.
Samples and opened packets fit the table; their combined footprint is unconfirmed.
Sample comparison can support assignment verification without an additional identification mechanism.
